description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, 2026-10-24), the Template-Toolkit-3.106 board census (the milestone named these three refusals; re-measured on 706cfde8 AND on s526w1's tree with #1026 -- still refused).  LOUD (whole module).

    my $t = "aXb"; my $n = 0;
    $t =~ s{X}{ if ($n) { "A" } else { $n = 5; "B" } }e;  print "$t $n\n";     # perl aBb 5
PCL: Transpile failed: "PCL: cannot compile the s///e replacement ... Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [Statement<$n = 5;>, Statement<B>]" (with a one-statement else: "Missing case: [Condition, Block, funcall]").
The replacement is a BLOCK of statements (perl compiles it like do { }), so a compound statement must lower through the statement path, as #1026 did for embedded anon-sub/map blocks.  TT shape (Filters.pm, Plugin/String.pm, VMethods.pm): `s{$search}{ my $s = $-[0]; my $e = $+[0]; if ($s == $e && $s == $prev_end) { "" } else { $prev_end = $e; $replace } }eg` (scratch/s526w2/p1.pl).
Rows: every TT test file that loads Template (most of the dist) -- counted in the TT census when it runs.

=== DONE (s526w2, resumed s528) ===
Pl/ExprToCL.pm _compile_subst_e_expr: when the statement-by-statement compile of the replacement fails, RETRY it as `do {REPLACEMENT\n}` -- perl compiles an /e replacement as a block, and a do-block is an ordinary expression whose block the enclosing parser lowers (the #1026 route).  Only on a replacement that already failed, so every shape that compiled keeps its emission.  Probe scratch/s526w2/pse.pl: perl `aBbAc 5 / aRb 2 / a6c` = tree.  Template::Filters, Template::Plugin::String, Template::VMethods now transpile (`./pl2cl --module`, no PCL: line).  Guard Pl/t/misc-fixes-01.t row 141, inverse-verified on a 31cd8c02 extraction (fails there).  Template-Toolkit still does not load: Template::Parser is #3856.
subject: An if/elsif/else STATEMENT inside an s///e replacement fails the whole TRANSPILE ("PCL: cannot compile the s///e replacement ... Fell through. Missing case") -- Template::Filters, Template::Plugin::String, Template::VMethods refuse (TT census)
